customize.name: Wilderness Exile
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>During the combat, an Abyssal Corrosion gauge will appear, and the Wild Hunt enemies will reanimate until its depleted</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After Rollon is attacked a few times, he will recover his mind and become an ally</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Head to</color> <color=#ece5d8>Piramida</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Check on the situation at the plaza</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Here you will see Illuga give a speech to the Ratniki regarding their current mission</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Afterwards, a man called Nikita will approach the player with a request</color>
